cheyenne.definition:
n. the capital and largest city of Wyoming; located in the southeastern corner of the state
n. the Algonquian language spoken by the Cheyenne
n. a member of a North American Indian people living on the western plains (now living in Oklahoma and Montana)
cheyenne.translation: n. 夏安族；夏安族人；夏安语

cheyennes.definition:
n. pl. A warlike tribe of indians, related to the
   blackfeet, formerly inhabiting the region of Wyoming, but now mostly on
   reservations in the Indian Territory. They are noted for their
   horsemanship.
cheyennes.translation: n. 夏安族（人）( Cheyenne的名词复数 )
